physical_interpretation.finding: Coastal ENEV METAR cloud cover and base height observations provide no robust incremental predictive value over the frozen Stage 8.1 control for Nuolja GHI forecasting under pre-registered protocol.
physical_interpretation.scope_limit: This closure applies strictly to this specific ENEV representation and feature formulation under the governed benchmark. It does NOT claim upstream observations are universally useless or that ENEV contains zero physical information.
physical_interpretation.physical_mechanism: Scandes mountain range acts as an orographic cloud barrier (upwind slope cloud trapping, lee wave cloud dissipation, and localized cloud transformation) decoupling coastal cloud decks at Evenes (86 km WNW) from inland microclimate cloud dynamics over Nuolja.
